high_level_description: This image depicts the interior of a coffee shop or a retail space dedicated to coffee products. The setting is clean and organized, with a modern and minimalist aesthetic. Shelving Units: There are multiple wooden shelves mounted on a white pegboard wall. These shelves hold various items including bags of coffee beans from the brand "VERVE," which is prominently displayed on the packaging. Coffee Bags: The shelves are stocked with different varieties of coffee beans, each bag labeled with the "VERVE" branding. The packaging varies in color, with some bags being green, white, and black.
